title: Fibre: 0 where it is a fact, and the plate counts what is known and says so
why: Coach Milan 22 November 2026, 22:31: fibre is super important, and fi? shows very often. 22:51: go with the two-part proposal; no made-up numbers as estimates. 23 November 15:33: draw DT342. 15:45: with foods missing the letter is fi*, the * as a footnote: approximate, not unknown. 16:20: plain milk products count as 0 (they have no fibre by nature); added fibre (inulin) blocks the 0.

opportunity.job: See the fibre of my plate and my day.
opportunity.kind: Did not understand it: fi? on most plates.
opportunity.why_now: Fibre is voluntary on EU labels, and many packs and Chef Mealan's added foods carry no fibre value, so most plates read fi?.

story: When I look at the fibre of my plate, I want to see what is known and which food is missing, so that I can still act on it.
proposed: 1. 0 where it is a fact: a food with no fibre value whose name says it has no fibre by nature (tea, coffee, water, salt, oil, sugar, meat, fish, eggs, plain milk products) counts as 0 fibre wherever foods are added up. Its own values stay as on its pack: what is on the package is what we show. 2. The rest counts what is known and says so: the plate's fibre reads X* g, and a * line says at least X g and names the foods without a value. The fibre letter is the known part's level with a *, fi*, Fi* or Fi+*: approximate, a footnote, not unknown (Coach Milan 15:45). fi? stays only when no food has a value. 3. That food's card says it has no fibre value and to add it from the pack in Review the label. No guessed numbers.
problem: A plate shows fi? as soon as one food on it has no fibre value, even when every other food has one. Tea, coffee, water, salt, oil, sugar, meat, fish, eggs and milk products have no fibre by nature, yet a missing value counts as unknown, and one empty value hides all the fibre that is known.
open: The rest of the word list in the design details, for Coach Milan to settle, as for DT336. Settled 16:20: plain milk products count as 0; inulin blocks.
checks: Middle: the Plate's letters and numbers, a food's card, a recipe's numbers. The unit tests with new ones for the list and the count; the build; a new walkthrough for AC1 to AC7; and the walkthroughs of the Plate's numbers and letters, about 10 minutes. New words on screen, so the German sweep too.
decision: Direction agreed 22 November 22:51. Drawn 23 November 2026 for Coach Milan's look. No Go, so nothing is built.
now: The Plate: chicken, rice, broccoli and olive oil from a pack that gives no fibre. The letters read fi?, and the numbers say Fibre ?, though the rice and the broccoli have about 6 g.
looked_at: A guessed fibre value from Chef Mealan or a table for a pack without one: not chosen (22:51), no made-up numbers. Setting 0 into the pack's own values: not chosen; the pack stays as printed and only the count uses 0. Keeping fi? with foods missing: not chosen (15:45); fi* says it is approximate, like a footnote.

ac.title: 0 where it is a fact
ac.text: Given olive oil from a pack with no fibre value on my plate, when the plate adds up its fibre, then the oil counts as 0, the plate shows a real fibre letter, and the oil's own values stay as on its pack

ac.title: The list
ac.text: Given a food with no fibre value, when its name says tea, coffee, water, salt, oil, sugar, meat, fish, eggs or a plain milk product, as a whole word in English, German or Serbian (Latin and Cyrillic), then it counts as 0; a word for something with fibre in it (muesli, fruit, chocolate, nuts, bread, breaded, vegetables, beans) or added fibre (inulin) blocks the 0 and always wins

ac.title: The numbers say why
ac.text: Given the plate's numbers open, when a food counts as 0 by nature, then one line names it: Olive oil counts as 0 fibre: none by nature

ac.title: What is known, at least
ac.text: Given a muesli bar with no fibre value on my plate, when I open the plate's numbers, then fibre reads 6* g and the * line says at least 6 g, 1 food without a value: Muesli bar

ac.title: The letter
ac.text: Given foods without a fibre value on my plate, when the other foods have fibre values, then the fibre letter is their level with a *: fi* under the plan (never fi-*, the missing food could lift it), Fi* On plan, Fi+* above; approximate, not unknown. fi? only when no food has a value

ac.title: The food's card
ac.text: Given the muesli bar's card, when it has no fibre value, then one line says so and to add it from the pack in Review the label; until then the plate's fibre has a *. A food on the list says it counts as 0 on my plate. No guessed number

ac.title: Each food's row
ac.text: Given olive oil on my plate, when I look at its row, then its letters read fi-, not fi?

unchanged: A food's own values: as on its pack, the fibre field empty when the pack gives none.
The fibre rate of the day, 14 g per 1,000 kcal, and the five letter levels.
A food with a fibre value: counted as it is.
details: Fibre-free by nature, whole words, the name only (the list to settle). Tea, coffee, water, salt (DT336's words). Oil: oil, Öl, Olivenöl, ulje. Sugar: sugar, Zucker, šećer. Meat: chicken, beef, pork, turkey, veal, lamb, ham, bacon, steak; Hähnchen, Huhn, Rind, Schwein, Pute, Kalb, Lamm, Schinken, Speck; piletina, junetina, svinjetina, ćuretina, teletina, jagnjetina, šunka, slanina. Fish: fish, salmon, tuna, cod, trout, sardines, mackerel, shrimp; Fisch, Lachs, Thunfisch, Kabeljau, Forelle, Garnelen; riba, losos, tunjevina, oslić, pastrmka, sardine, škampi. Eggs: egg, Ei, jaje. Milk products: milk, yogurt, skyr, quark, cheese, butter, kefir; Milch, Joghurt, Käse; mleko, jogurt, sir, maslac, kajmak. Serbian also in Cyrillic.

Words that block the 0 and always win: muesli, granola, fruit and common fruits (strawberry, banana, blueberry), chocolate, cocoa, nuts, oats, bread, breaded (paniert, pohovan), cereal, vegetables, beans, tomato, seeds, jam, cake, biscuits, pizza, burger, sandwich, wrap, salad, juice; added fibre: inulin, chicory fibre, Inulin, Ballaststoffe, Chicorée-Faser, inulin, vlakna (Coach Milan 16:20); in German and Serbian too. A fruit yoghurt or breaded chicken is not 0.
The same count wherever foods are added up: the Plate, Plate read, a recipe's numbers.
The pictures are the real app on one scratch build of main, not committed, with the clock on Monday 23 November 2026, 16:00.
short: Fibre: 0 where it is a fact; with a food missing, fi* and at least X g
rel: Proposed; not agreed until Coach Milan says Go
